note: How Sarvadristhi supports each guideline. 'Supported' means the workflow produces what the guideline asks for; it is not a certification, which only an accredited body or court can give.

standards.title: Guidelines for identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of digital evidence

items.ask: Recognise and document potential digital evidence and its context
items.how: Evidence registration with source path, size, kind and examiner; format family identified from bytes with all hypotheses kept

items.ask: Create a copy by a documented, repeatable method and verify it
items.how: Raw/E01 imaging with MD5 + SHA-256 (sarvadristhi acquire); evidence opened read-only and re-hashed after analysis

items.ask: Protect integrity and keep a chain of custody
items.how: Hash-chained custody ledger re-verified on open; every examiner action logged

items.ask: Another examiner can evaluate and repeat the process
items.how: Replay capsule: byte ranges of every clip, signed; replay on another machine reproduces each clip hash

items.ask: Decisions and methods can be justified
items.how: Proof drawer shows source bytes → method → frames → clip → time basis for every result; limitations stated per format

standards.title: Best Practices for Data Acquisition from Digital Video Recorders

items.ask: Document the DVR clock against a reference time
items.how: Clock correction records the examiner's offset with its basis; overlay-vs-recorder drift and clock changes measured per camera

items.ask: Prefer native/proprietary exports and preserve them
items.how: Raw elementary streams kept beside MP4 derivatives; exports matched frame-by-frame to recorder footage

items.ask: Image the hard drive when native export is not possible or deleted data matters, with write protection
items.how: acquire with write-blocker attestation; deleted and overwritten footage recovered from the image

items.ask: Use the recorder's export interface when imaging is not appropriate, and document it
items.how: Live acquisition pulls footage over ONVIF/vendor APIs and logs device identity, clock and every download
items.status: supported (tested on a simulated recorder only)

items.ask: Keep the means to play proprietary formats
items.how: Clips remuxed to MP4 without re-encoding (H.264 and H.265); raw streams kept
Evidence builder builds vendor-layout images with frame-level ground truth (H.264, H.265, Honeywell, relabelled disks)
Recorder validation scores a real recorder image against a handwritten event log
items.status: kit ready; no physical recorder run yet

items.ask: State context and limits of the AI
items.how: AI output labelled as leads; disclaimer on every AI view
Activity recall and precision bound scored against MEVA human labels

items.ask: Keep humans in control of consequential use
items.how: Only examiner-accepted leads become findings; Ask the case refuses identity questions

standards.title: Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam: admissibility of electronic records

items.ask: Device, hash values and conditions of the electronic record
items.how: Annex A of the report carries the data sheet; signatures and the certificate itself remain the examiner's
items.status: data sheet supported; admissibility is for the court

items.how: Runs only on 127.0.0.1; no cloud services; footage never leaves the workstation
items.status: supported (legal applicability for the authority to assess)
